_comment: Pinned, redistributable build toolchains CEditor provisions so a user can export every language WITHOUT pre-installing Visual Studio / .NET SDK / GraalVM. provision.mjs downloads the entry matching the host platform into tools/toolchains/<id>/. The installer bundles or downloads these (see tools/installer/CEditor.iss). Binaries are gitignored — never committed.

llvm-mingw.desc: Self-contained Clang/LLD C/C++ toolchain (no Visual Studio, no Windows SDK). Builds the JUCE plugin AND the C-ABI handler modules; its lld-link also backs the C# NativeAOT link step.

python-embed.desc: CPython Windows embeddable runtime, bundled INTO the exported plugin so Python panels run with zero user install. (mac/Linux use python-build-standalone — added when those export hosts are wired.)

ninja.desc: Ninja build tool — the generator used to build the JUCE plugin with the bundled LLVM-MinGW Clang (CMake's MSVC generator isn't available without Visual Studio). Tiny.

dotnet.desc: Portable .NET SDK (Roslyn + MSBuild + publish). Dev-side: compiles the user's C# handlers to a managed ce_managed.dll and self-contained-publishes a CoreCLR beside it (see nativeHandlers/csharp). Installed via Microsoft's dotnet-install script into tools/toolchains/dotnet/ — NO admin, NO Visual Studio. The shipped plugin embeds only the (MIT) CoreCLR, never the SDK.

jdk.desc: Temurin JDK 21 (LTS). Dev-side javac+jlink: compile Java handlers to bytecode and emit a ~30-50MB trimmed JRE shipped INTO the plugin (JNI). Pinned to 21 because JDK 24+ drops jmods/ (JEP 493), breaking cross-platform jlink.

_dotnet_note: C# uses NativeAOT 'slim packs' (ILCompiler + runtime pack, ~40MB) restored from nuget at first export, linked with the lld-link from llvm-mingw — no full .NET SDK. Wired in nativeHandlers/csharp; see native-handlers-design.md.
